title: Gallery Intro
description: Featured research: Barberini Ivory, Roman Wall Sconce, and Susanna and the Elders. The illustrated reliefs and fan remain fixed scenery until their identities are confirmed.

title: Conservation Lab Intro
description: Ivory as a medium: workmanship, materials, artistic traditions, and conservation evidence. Compare the collection on the central table with histories across centuries.

title: Historical Society Intro
description: Community memory, collecting practices, and the local lives of objects. The piano and billiards table connect materials to everyday social spaces.

title: Attic Intro
description: Inheritance, rediscovery, storage, and documentary gaps. An object found in a trunk does not establish who made, owned, or transferred it.

title: Natural History Intro
description: Elephants, ivory as material, and environmental history. Explore deep time, maps, specimen interpretation, and a separate evidence-ordering activity.

title: Conservators Office Intro
description: Care, repair, research and preservation. Exhibition assembly at the terminal remains a future feature.

title: Lab Intro
description: Technical analysis and material investigation. Lab is distinct from Conservation Lab; its attic context describes the investigation of rediscovered objects.
